sloka: रामस्य लोकरामस्य भ्रातुः ज्येष्ठस्य नित्यशः ।सर्व प्रिय करः तस्य रामस्य अपि शरीरतः ॥१-१८-२९॥
transliteration: rāmasya lokarāmasya bhrātuḥ jyeṣṭhasya nityaśaḥ ।sarva priya karaḥ tasya rāmasya api śarīrataḥ ॥1-18-29॥

translations.english: Rama, the greatest among men would not sleep without Lakshmana's company. He would not partake even the choicest food minus to him.
